definition.context: confirmed 4H trend and wall break, then first matching 15m retest
definition.entry: next 15m open after the shape closes on the breakout side
definition.pin_bar: directional body; rejection wick >= 2x body and 0.25 ATR; opposite wick <= body
definition.engulfing: directional real body fully engulfs the previous opposite real body
definition.exit: full exit at strict RR 1:1; same-bar TP/SL ambiguity counted as loss

pin_bar.name_ja: ピンバー（長い反転ヒゲ）
